source.snippet: I'm trying to adjust the layout of my Squarespace Request a Quote form. The only issue is with this form; my Contact form and everything else are fine. I need the Requirement Details textarea to span both columns, and I need the Upload Requirements field to sit directly below it, with the Submit Request button aligned to the right. I cannot get this to work through the Squarespace interface and need CSS help.

problem_statement: Small business owners using Squarespace hit hard limits on form layout customisation (multi-column spans, field ordering, file upload placement) that require CSS workarounds most non-developers cannot implement, blocking professional quote and intake form designs.
target_segment: Small business owners and freelancers running service businesses on Squarespace who need custom intake or quote forms but lack front-end development skills
notes: Buyer context: Squarespace users pay $23–$65/month for their site. They are running a real business (Request a Quote form implies a service business). They are already paying for tooling and are clearly willing to pay more to solve this — a Squarespace form customisation micro-SaaS or done-for-you CSS snippet service (e.g. $29 one-time or $9/mo) could slot in here. The broader Squarespace customisation pain is well-documented on Reddit and YouTube. Single post; signal strength kept low for this batch.
